limitations: Not the unpublished champion network or training pipeline
Only 192 collected games and 1600 optimizer updates
Additive construction and independent ink head cannot represent within-action interactions
Full WAIT Q is fixed zero: no gradient on full WAIT, nonnegative bootstrap maximum
Undiscounted potential delta with gamma .99 is a shaped objective, not policy-invariant discounted shaping
Training v09 is seat 0 and neural-v1 seat 1; both-player transitions are retained
Float16 replay storage and Java/Python summation can affect untested near ties
